skill.name: visioncraft
skill.description: Generate images and videos with Agnes AI from natural-language prompts. Supports text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video, multi-image video, and keyframe animation.
skill.summary: Create AI images, videos, and keyframe animations through Agnes AI PowerShell workflows.
skill.author: BAI-32

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code fences, placeholder URLs, PowerShell syntax, and documentation text. Confirmed risks are intentional local PowerShell script execution, AGNES_API_KEY access, outbound Agnes API calls, and an unsafe instruction to echo the API key. No prompt injection text was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: The setup guide tells users to echo AGNES_API_KEY.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the echo check with a boolean presence check that never prints the key value.

remediation.issue: The skill sends prompts, image URLs, and settings to Agnes AI endpoints.
remediation.suggestion: Add a clear pre-run disclosure and require confirmation before sending private prompts or reference images.

remediation.issue: The scripts print full prompts and generation settings to the console.
remediation.suggestion: Add a quiet or redacted logging mode for sensitive prompts and customer media references.

remediation.issue: The skill relies on local PowerShell scripts for core workflows.
remediation.suggestion: Keep commands restricted to bundled scripts, validate URL inputs, and document that agent auto-install should require confirmation.

content.user_title: Create Images and Videos with Agnes AI
content.value_statement: Creative teams need fast ways to turn visual ideas into generated media. VisionCraft guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Agnes AI image and video workflows.
actual_capabilities: Generates images from text prompts with size and aspect ratio controls.
Transforms existing image URLs or data URIs with image-to-image prompts.
Creates videos from text prompts using configurable ratio, duration, frame rate, and seed values.
Animates one reference image or uses multiple images for guided video generation.
Supports keyframe animation between two or more image references.
Prints a MEDIA URL when Agnes AI returns a hosted image or video.
limitations: Requires PowerShell 7+ and is documented as Windows-first.
Requires a valid Agnes AI API key stored in AGNES_API_KEY.
Sends prompts, image references, and generation settings to the Agnes AI API.
Video jobs can take many minutes and may require manual polling after timeout.

use_cases.title: Produce Campaign Visuals
use_cases.description: Generate product posters, social covers, and concept images from brand prompts.

use_cases.title: Prototype Video Concepts
use_cases.description: Create short cinematic clips to test motion ideas before production.

use_cases.title: Animate Reference Frames
use_cases.description: Turn still images or keyframes into smooth transitions for storyboards and previews.

prompt_templates.prompt: Use VisionCraft to create a square image of [subject] in [style] with [lighting] and [mood].

prompt_templates.title: Restyle an Existing Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use VisionCraft to transform this image URL into [new style]. Preserve [important elements] and change [target elements].

prompt_templates.title: Create a Short Video
prompt_templates.prompt: Use VisionCraft to create a [duration] [aspect ratio] video of [subject] doing [action] with [camera movement].

prompt_templates.title: Animate Keyframes
prompt_templates.prompt: Use VisionCraft keyframe mode to transition from these images. Maintain [identity], [camera angle], and [visual style].

output_examples.input: Generate a cinematic harbor city image at sunset.
output_examples.output: VisionCraft returns a hosted image URL and reports the requested size and generation time.

output_examples.input: Animate this portrait with subtle motion for an eight second vertical clip.
output_examples.output: VisionCraft creates a video task, polls for completion, and returns the final hosted video URL.

output_examples.input: Create a smooth transition between two supplied keyframe images.
output_examples.output: VisionCraft uses keyframe mode and returns a generated transition video when the job completes.

best_practices: Use clear prompts that describe subject, scene, style, lighting, and composition.
State what to preserve when transforming or animating an existing image.
Use ratio and duration shortcuts before changing low-level frame settings.
anti_patterns: Do not include private, regulated, or confidential content in prompts without approval.
Do not paste real API keys into prompts, scripts, issues, or documentation.
Do not expect long video jobs to finish instantly or without polling.

faq.question: What does VisionCraft create?
faq.answer: It creates AI images, AI videos, image transformations, image animations, multi-image videos, and keyframe transitions.

faq.question: Which service does it use?
faq.answer: It uses Agnes AI API endpoints through bundled PowerShell scripts.

faq.question: Does it need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. The scripts require AGNES_API_KEY in the environment before requests can run.

faq.question: Can it work from existing images?
faq.answer: Yes. It accepts public image URLs and documented data URI inputs for image-to-image and video workflows.

faq.question: Where are results returned?
faq.answer: The scripts print a MEDIA URL for the generated image or video when the service returns one.

faq.question: What should users review before running it?
faq.answer: Users should review external API use, prompt privacy, image URL privacy, and local PowerShell script execution.
